description.value:
Dormant · Imprisoned · The Campaign's Endgame Threat

Sent in 2100 to force humanity to stop killing itself; instead the corporations and kingdoms that had spent a century at each other's throats united to cage him and bleed his power into their own weapons. God withdrew. Around 2110 Uriel broke — turning humanity's own war machines and nuclear arsenals against it in a single night, The Turning — then vanished. Now dormant in a prison no one has located, the seal slowly rusting through; the Glasslands is the usual guess. The Choir of Ash worships him and works to free him, believing his "cleansing" was righteous and unfinished. Vigil's take is more complicated: tragedy, not villainy — a fellow victim of what was done to him, not a monster to be simply cheered against.
